locality.sibling_roop_ultimate: external/read-only; no edits or model writes permitted

execution_graph.queue: JobStore/JobWorker; bounded AsyncPipeline queues; optional PinnedFramePool

execution_graph.notes: Reference session replay; 6GB preview caps the long edge at 512; preview is not the FFmpeg stream runner.

execution_graph.separate_api: app/roop_3d/server/queue_routes.py:/batch/submit expands BatchMatrixEngine manifests into QueueManager rows; this is a separate queue API, not the current BatchMatrixScreen dispatch path.
execution_graph.matrix_contract: Per-file and recipe matrix generation validate WorkstationParameters; effective restorer is serialized as restorer_model and controls output naming.

identity_asset.mesh_signature: identity_asset_mesh(faceset_id, request, template='canonical', topology=None, jaw_width=0, cheekbone_prominence=0, chin_projection=0, nose_bridge=0, brow_arch=0, face_fullness=0, albedo_prior=False)
identity_asset.template: MakeHumanHeadModel.load(path=None, auto_build=False, verify=True); pinned CC0-1.0 source data; MakeHuman is explicitly selected/built, not the identity-asset default.
identity_asset.settings: IdentityAssetSettings.uv_size defaults to 512 (maximum 2048); template defaults canonical; MakeHuman mesh fitting supports multi-view observations.
identity_asset.uv: UVSynthesizer(mesh, uv_size=512, visibility_threshold=0.05, max_interpolation_fraction=None, blend_mode='weighted', visibility_backend='cpu', intrinsic_texture_decomposer=None); multi-view visibility/quality-weighted BGR synthesis; Telea inpainting for face-geometry holes; non-face unseen texels stay zero/UNSEEN.
identity_asset.integration_gap: A01 connected explicit asset sessions: prepare_session may build/reuse a supplied IdentityAssetStore asset or load its exact cached asset, validates build key/FaceSet/source hashes, and creates IdentityRig. Explicit pose_3d uses the identity-asset projector; reenactment_3d uses ReenactmentEngine. Missing/mismatched assets report rig_status and retain an explicit canonical-proxy fallback. The mesh API remains a separate viewer/export route; FullHeadEngine remains disabled.

bisenet_input.normalization: zero_one, minus_one_one, or ImageNet, configured per parser

ultramax_input.graph: (1,3,512,512) FP16 image + scalar w DOUBLE for the registered codeformer.fp16.onnx record

ultramax_output.adapter_output: (S,S,3) uint8 BGR; S=max(input crop side, spec.size)

interfaces.neural_face: NeuralFaceEngine.process(image, face, document, swapper, *, track_id, frame_index=None, timestamp=None, scene_cut=False, pose_confidence=1.0); BGR uint8 image/crop; source/target camera-space geometry and rasterized correspondence fields are float32 NumPy arrays.
interfaces.compositor: FrameCompositor.compose(frame, replacements, landmarks_by_track=None, *, scene_cut=False, frame_index=None, occluder_masks=None, mask_temporal_context=None, lip_sync_results=None, options=CompositeOptions(), observer=None, background_donors=None) -> uint8 BGR frame; defaults now use four-level MULTI_BAND and CompositeOptions.xseg_occlusion_strength=1.0
interfaces.occlusion: OcclusionAnalyzer.analyze(crop, landmarks, *, feather_px=5.0, confidence_threshold=0.55, explicit_front=None, border_trust=0.6, track_id=None, trust_frames=3, mesh_support=None, xseg_occlusion_strength=1.0) -> FaceAnalysis; strength is 0..1 and scales neural visible-face subtraction only
interfaces.restorer_registry: ModelCatalog.ultramax_spec() resolves load_ultramax_spec(pin_root); ModelCatalog.weight_available(model_id, filename) checks the verified provider path used for availability.
interfaces.restoration_telemetry: Observed applied/bypassed/failed outcomes, mean latency/inference time, and last event; asynchronous device dispatch explicitly reports latency as unmeasured.
interfaces.workstation_parameters: WorkstationParameters adds xseg_occlusion_strength (float 0..1, default 1.0), blend_mode (enum, default multi_band), and pyramid_levels (int 4..6, default 4); composite_options() passes them to CompositeOptions.
interfaces.live_preview_payload: LivePreviewPayload carries the same three fields; cache digest/applied list include them; incompatible frequency_separated combinations are rejected and inert fields are reported in meta.unsupported.

ui_status.diagnostic_overlays: No new mesh wireframe, semantic+XSeg probability overlay, seam ring, or pre/post UltraMax split. Preview exposes pose/matte/swapper/restorer buffers, but not the missing geometry/probability/ring data.

evidence: landmark_hull_mask uses Gaussian feathering; BiSeNet classes and occluder subtraction remain available
CompositeOptions now defaults to four-level MULTI_BAND; zero-alpha occluder pixels are restored after pyramid reconstruction
color/detail sampling uses trusted skin class 1 plus nose class 10; insufficient trusted skin is reported rather than replaced by full-face color statistics
signed-distance anatomical feathering and confidence/energy-gated target DoG microtexture retention are implemented
findings.gap: No spatial five-zone LAB matching or dedicated target/source pigment detector. Source marks can only come from an actual textured 3D source route.

evidence: BiSeNet adapter returns 19-class probabilities; FaceRegions maps skin/brows/eyes/glasses/ears/nose/mouth/lips/neck/clothing/hair/hat
landmark and dense geometry paths use 5/106/68-point observations; 478-point gaze detail is optional in FullHeadEngine
findings.gap: Parser has no tongue or teeth class (teeth remain a heuristic used only for restoration protection). Target oral-cavity preservation is not a general post-swap composite operation. IdentityRig expression deformation is now reachable through explicitly selected identity-asset/reenactment modes, not every standard render.

evidence: NeuralFaceEngine uses source/target depth-tested correspondence and rasterized coverage; FullHeadEngine uses solvePnPRansac + LM refinement and GPU depth/UV rasterization
FrameCompositor warps crops into frame space and preserves pixels outside the dilated blend support
full-head silhouette replacement has donor-based/multiscale inpainting and reports changed pixels
findings.gap: Dense-asset absence and roll beyond ROOP3D_3D_MAX_ROLL (default 40 degrees) still route to standard 2D. Explicit pose_3d now uses the validated identity-asset projector when available; missing assets use a reported canonical-proxy fallback. FullHeadEngine remains disabled and end-to-end zero-halo behavior is not established.

evidence: automatic dense 3D trigger defaults to yaw >30 degrees or pitch >25 degrees; roll >40 degrees falls back to standard 2D
FaceSet source views and depth-tested correspondence provide multi-view appearance; target high-frequency skin texture can be reinjected and skin detail can be transferred
findings.gap: No explicit target mole/freckle detector or source pigment re-anchoring was found. Target texture retention is a high-pass/skin-mask mechanism, not a source mole projection. FullHeadEngine animation and observed-pose coverage are constrained by measured landmarks/views; 80-degree performance is not guaranteed by the session routing.

evidence: reference, preview, video, and optimized paths now resolve UltraMax through ModelCatalog.ultramax_spec() -> load_ultramax_spec(pin_root)
codeformer.fp16 is registered as an UltraMax alias; system capability uses ModelCatalog.weight_available against the verified provider path
observed applied/bypassed/failed outcomes and latency telemetry are recorded; inference errors still raise
findings.gap: UltraMax remains CodeFormer fp16 plus Laplacian detail fusion, not a GPEN/Real-ESRGAN cascade. Full-chain CUDA zero-copy is absent; zero restoration blend occurs upstream and is not counted by the restorer telemetry.

evidence: standard compositor runs BiSeNet and semantic forbidden-class masks
robust mode uses OcclusionAnalyzer with xseg_3.onnx and face_occluder.onnx; the visible-face maps are combined conservatively with minimum probability and fused with semantic/explicit masks
findings.gap: XSeg/face-occluder and parser inputs/outputs remain host NumPy; no GPU-native fused-mask path. xseg_occlusion_strength now scales neural visible-face subtraction from 0..1; semantic and explicit occluders remain full-strength. Missing networks are reported, not synthesized.

evidence: UVSynthesizer projects multiple FaceSet observations with visibility/quality weighting; MakeHuman fitting and view textures are supported
IdentityRig.texture_for_pose selects a view-attended UV albedo
findings.gap: UV size defaults to 512; unseen face texels use bounded Telea inpainting, not symmetric Poisson completion. The selected identity-asset pose/reenactment routes now consume validated stored assets; FullHeadEngine remains disabled.

evidence: NeuralFaceEngine uses CoupledTrackSmoother for landmarks/fits and source-view hysteresis
FrameCompositor uses One-Euro affine, alpha and ColorStats smoothing; mask EMA/flow, histogram filtering and temporal detail stabilization exist
FullHeadEngine and ReenactmentEngine have pose/expression/anchor temporal filters
findings.gap: IdentityRig/Reenactment filters are reachable in explicitly selected asset modes, but not every render uses them; no guarantee of filtering every 6DoF/vertex channel. Spatial five-zone LAB statistics remain absent.

evidence: BiSeNet/visible-face/OrtModel APIs accept NumPy host arrays and return NumPy arrays
OpenGL rasterizers explicitly read framebuffer bytes into copied NumPy arrays
UltraMax I/O binding binds CPU inputs; outputs are materialized with OrtValue.numpy(), then converted to BGR uint8
compositing/frequency/color/mask work uses NumPy/OpenCV
findings.gap: GPU inference/rasterization exists, but no GPU-resident tensor chain from swapper through segmentation, compositing, and restoration; TensorRT/FP16 alone does not provide zero-copy.

evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs Python gates 1,2,7,9,10,11,14 and frontend typecheck/lint/Vitest/build; its matrix passes one integer per --gate invocation, matching tools/ci_runner.py argparse.

A real-browser walk-through (headed, backend on 127.0.0.1:8030) found and fixed two UI bugs: a React.lazy re-export in ThreeViewport that crashed the Inspector, and pre-flight lint warnings hidden below the first four PASS rows (now sorted FAIL, WARN, PASS). A 2 s clip completed import, inspect, assign, live preview and full render (60 verified frames).

Final full Python suite (roop_3d/tests, no other load): 2959 passed, 46 skipped, 0 failed, 1 warning, 13 subtests passed in 2736.74s. Earlier runs: 14 failed, then 4 failed; all compositor regressions were fixed without weakening thresholds.
findings.gap: Whole-video face inspection is a single blocking request with no progress or cancel and was not fixed. Only a 2 s clip was walked end to end; a 7 minute video was still inspecting after about 9 minutes. Native CV-CUDA/TensorRT zero-copy GPU residency, a tongue model, a source-pigment detector and five-zone LAB transfer remain unimplemented.

ownership_rules: No agent edits files owned by another agent; no shared-file edits or sibling-repository writes.
The listed tensor/color/dtype contracts are fixed interfaces unless the owning agent updates this contract and explicitly communicates the migration before implementation.

Do not invent tongue/teeth classes, GPU-native behavior, model weights, or test results. Where model artifacts do not support a requested capability, report the limitation and preserve fail-closed behavior.
Keep model license, hash, and local-trust controls; fix incorrect adapter selection without bypassing governance.
Subagents do not run tests, lint, typecheck, builds, or formatters mid-flight; the integration owner runs the narrow verification once after all changes.
